title: What will Donald Trump say during midterm rally in Lubbock, Texas originally scheduled for October 27, 2026? Ceasefire
rules:
If 
 Donald Trump says Ceasefire as part of midterm rally in Lubbock, Texas originally scheduled for October 27, 2026
, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Video of the midterm rally in Lubbock, Texas originally scheduled for October 27, 2026 using the live broadcast or stream.
If a consensus by Kalshi employees cannot be reached using video, internal & external (official) transcripts of the midterm rally in Lubbock, Texas originally scheduled for October 27, 2026 will be used.

Payout Criteria
The exact phrase/word, or a plural or possessive form of the phrase/word. 
Plural nouns occurring within proper nouns and noun phrases (e.g. names, titles, etc).
Donald Trump speaking in an official capacity.
For phrases with slashes like "Doge/Dogecoin," either word satisfies the criterion.

Doesn't count for payout
Grammatical/tense inflections are otherwise not included. 
Additional content not included in the original broadcast or stream.
Presence alone during a livestream is not sufficient for the market to qualify (e.g., inaudible private conversations on camera, unofficial statements picked up on a hot mic).
Except as otherwise specified, previously aired content, archival footage, and recordings captured at times, places, or events wholly separate from the featured address.

Payout for cancellations and delays
If an event is definitively cancelled or the event fails to qualify under the Payout Criterion, or any other circumstance prevents normal resolution, then the market for "Event does not qualify" resolves to Yes and all other markets will resolve to No.  
If the event is postponed, and such a postponement is announced by the end of the following calendar day to be rescheduled to a time within 14 calendar days, the markets shall remain open.

blind.reasoning: The Lubbock rally is confirmed for the evening of Oct 27, 2026. Trump just called the Iran ceasefire a 'waste of time' at a Mississippi midterm rally, he recently announced a Russia–Ukraine 'energy ceasefire', and a Melania-brokered ceasefire in Oleshky started the same day. With three ceasefire stories in the news and his habit of long, freewheeling rally speeches that repeat stump material, saying the word at least once is very likely. The main risks are a cancellation or a shorter speech focused on domestic issues.
blind.falsifier: A full transcript or video of the Oct 27 Lubbock rally shows Trump never saying 'ceasefire', or the rally is cancelled.

final.reasoning: A 20% price on rally day probably means the speech is in progress or done without 'ceasefire' so far, so I'm cutting my estimate sharply. With three live ceasefire stories and his recent rally use of the word, I still put it slightly above the market, but with low confidence.
